decision: Ruling R10 (likelihood lifecycle epic, recommended 2026-10-21; carried out 2026-11-01 under autolens_profiling#503): the stalled setup-baseline protocol is replaced, not resumed. The day-zero baseline answers its unknowns.

answers.unknown: No frozen project/library revisions or environment lock chosen.
answers.answer: Pinned to the released tag 2026.10.25.1 (catalogue/release_revisions.json maps it to library SHAs); the environment is the RAL shared venv (jax/jaxlib 0.11.2, eigen flag on CPU legs) recorded by each row's identity block.

answers.unknown: No collection authorization or time window.
answers.answer: Collected by the phase-2 campaigns 2a-2g and the phase-3 JAX rows under per-batch human go (ruling R9; CPU on --partition=ral only).

answers.unknown: Hardware/affinity/environment identity unselected; thread/load/method limits are proposals.
answers.answer: Reference hosts hpc_ral_cpu and hpc_a100 only (ruling R7: laptop rows never current); each row records its host, threads and resources; projected node throughput declares parallel efficiency 1.0 until phase 4 measures it.

answers.unknown: Each cell requires explicit complete settings and input hashes plus correctness witness and tolerances.
answers.answer: Settings are the cell script plus its dataset (mirrored results tree); the witness is the cell's parity.json (reference log-likelihood and tolerance, status match) plus its fit.png.

answers.unknown: Compile per-cell builder unavailable; memory/breakdown instrumentation must demonstrate this protocol before collection.
answers.answer: Compile cost is recorded where available but is not an axis of the Optimal class (ruling R5); breakdown and memory rows are stamped with their cell.

answers.unknown: Proposed fp64/mixed coverage is not evidence of support; enumerate exposes unsupported and unverified cells.
answers.answer: Day zero is fp64; mixed precision is class experimental everywhere (ruling R4). Coverage is the designation-driven plan: 232 planned cells, all current; no optimal cell is not_measured.
